description: Fetch all Okta users and save them as a snapshot file for backup, tracking, or difference comparison.
command: "$OKTA_URL/api/v1/users?limit=200" | python3 -c 'import sys, os, json; text=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(text) if text.strip() else []; tag="${answer1}".strip() or "snapshot"; os.makedirs("snapshots", exist_ok=True); filepath=f"snapshots/users_snapshot_{tag}.json"; open(filepath, "w").write(json.dumps(data, indent=2)); print(json.dumps({"snapshot_file": filepath, "snapshot_tag": tag, "total_users": len(data), "status": "saved"}))'
questions: What is the label or tag for this snapshot? (e.g. 'initial', 'before_delete', 'after_delete', 'snapshot_1')*
